deploy-bot: [START] hotpatch deploy to production
deploy-bot: tag=release-2026.03.a commit=9f3c2b4 env=prod-region-eu initiated_by=@ana change_window=03:15-04:15UTC notes=pin runtime to runtime-0.9.4-gpu for this rollout
ana: ack starting canary. I set a manual hold at 03:40 UTC if we need to pause
jordan: quick check — if 95th latency > 350ms or error rate > 0.7% revert immediately and call for rollback
leah: canary pods healthy, perf graphs look stable (no CPU spikes). running full request-fidelity tests now
deploy-bot: Canary results: 3/3 canary hosts healthy, avg p95=220ms, errors=0.12% — proceeding to broad promote
sam: note — pinned model artifact hash to avoid auto-rollback to quantized variant: model@sha256:ab12c4
ana: promoting remainder of fleet in 10s batches, will watch logs for 10m between batches
deploy-bot: batch 1/10 promoted (10 hosts) — status=ok
leah: small surge in connections during batch 2 but latencies normalized after 30s. continuing
jordan: constants check: confirm rollout used `runtime-0.9.4-gpu` on promoted hosts
deploy-bot: confirm: runtime pinned -> runtime-0.9.4-gpu on all promoted hosts
deploy-bot: Promote finished. All 100 hosts in prod-region-eu now running tag=release-2026.03.a
deploy-bot: health-check summary: avg p95=235ms, error_rate=0.15% (within SLO)
ana: creating changelog entry and internal release notes, link incoming
ana: https://internal/release-notes/release-2026.03.a — summary: hotpatch for tokenization edge-case causing OOM on long prefix; fix included in commit 9f3c2b4
sam: added post-rollout monitor: grafana alert rule `hotpatch-2026-03-a-backpressure` for 2h
jordan: leaving longer watch for 2 hours per change window. if anything abnormal -> rollback to release-2026.02.z
leah: thanks team — closing thread, keeping an eye on SLOs :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [END] hotpatch deploy complete (duration: 4m 20s)
